code: m <- punkst_read_model(run2@model)          # genes x topics round(head(m[order(rownames(m)), ], 4)) topics <- punkst_read_topics(run2@model)    # one row per hexagon head(topics, 3) frac_a <- vapply(as.data.frame(m), function(v)     sum(v[startsWith(rownames(m), "A")]) / sum(v), 0) round(frac_a, 2) tp <- topics[, -(1:3)] top <- max.col(as.matrix(tp), "first") plot(topics$x, topics$y, col = c("#d95f02", "#1b9e77")[top], pch = 15, cex = 0.5,      asp = 1, xlab = "x", ylab = "y", main = "Dominant topic per hexagon")

text: stage function exposes options matching punkst command punkst’s defaults (see ?punkst_pts2tiles, ?punkst_tiles2hex, ?punkst_topic_model), run_punkst_pipeline() takes stage’s options list. can also call stages one time (sdata_export(), punkst_pts2tiles(), punkst_tiles2hex(), punkst_topic_model()), taking previous stage’s result. stage writes log workdir, manifest records parameters inputs; re-running skips stages whose outputs exist whose parameters input files unchanged (overwrite = TRUE forces re-run).

title: Tile a transcript file (punkst pts2tiles) — punkst_pts2tiles
text: tsv Input delimited file (---tsv), e.g. sdata_export(). workdir Directory outputs, logs manifest. tile_size Tile size input's coordinate units (--tile-size). Required. icol_x, icol_y, icol_feature 0-based columns x, y feature (--icol-x, --icol-y, --icol-feature). icol_feature = NULL omits feature column feature dictionary output. icol_z Optional 0-based z column (--icol-z). icol_int Optional 0-based integer-value (count) columns (--icol-int). csv Treat input CSV (--csv); punkst otherwise infers file extension. keep_quotes 0-based columns keep quoted CSV output (--keep-quotes). skip Number input lines skip (--skip). skip_last_is_header Treat last skipped line header (--skip-last--header). Lines starting # top detected automatically, needed sdata_export() output. scale Uniform coordinate scale factor (--scale). scale_x, scale_y, scale_z Per-axis scale factors override scale (--scale-x, --scale-y, --scale-z). digits Precision rewritten coordinates scaling applied (--digits). include_cols, exclude_cols 0-based columns keep drop tiled output (--include-cols, --exclude-cols; mutually exclusive). column positions tiled file differ input, pass matching icol_* punkst_tiles2hex(). tile_buffer Buffer lines per tile per thread (--tile-buffer). batch_size Batch size lines gzipped streamed input (--batch-size). temp_dir Directory temporary files (--temp-dir); default <workdir>/tmp_pts2tiles. threads Number threads (--threads). verbose, debug Verbosity debug level (--verbose, --debug). bin Path punkst; see punkst_setup(). overwrite Re-run even date.

title: punkstR 0.99.0
text: Initial release: thin, system2()-based R driver punkst spatial transcriptomics pipeline (reticulate, Python imported R). check_punkst_setup() locates punkst binary Python interpreter spatialdata installed. sdata_export() exports SpatialData (zarr) points elements transcript format punkst expects. Formal S7 classes model pipeline stages: punkstConfig, punkstStage (punkstTiles/punkstHex/punkstModel subclasses), punkstRun. Stage wrappers (punkst_tiles(), punkst_hex(), punkst_topic_model()) one-call run_punkst_pipeline(), manifest-based skipping stages already date. Result readers: punkst_read_model(), punkst_read_topics(), punkst_read_hex(), punkst_read_features(), match_xy(). sdata_writeback() writes run’s hexagon shapes topic results back SpatialData store (new sidecar store default, place); sdata_runs() lists stored runs; punkst_compare_runs() compares two runs’ topic loadings (, grids match, per-hexagon topic agreement) without needing Python. sdata_demo() builds small synthetic SpatialData store package’s vignette examples.

Fixed latent bug punkst_compare_runs() per-hexagon agreement computation ran outside try() meant make optional. Added GitHub Actions workflow (R-CMD-check.yaml) running R CMD check BiocCheck every push/PR, installing real Python environment (numpy/pandas/scipy/spatialdata) prebuilt punkst binary vignette examples actually run CI rather skipped.
